265static inline bool rayTriangleMT(float3 ro, float3 rd, float3 v0, float3 v1,
266 float3 v2, thread float &t, thread float &u,
267 thread float &v) {
268 float3 e1 = v1 - v0;
269 float3 e2 = v2 - v0;
270 float3 p = cross(rd, e2);
271 float det = dot(e1, p);
272
273 if (fabs(det) < 1e-8f)
274 return false;
275 float invDet = 1.0f / det;
276
277 float3 s = ro - v0;
278 u = dot(s, p) * invDet;
279 if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f)
280 return false;
281
282 float3 q = cross(s, e1);
283 v = dot(rd, q) * invDet;
284 if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f)
285 return false;
286
287 t = dot(e2, q) * invDet;
288 return t > 0.0f;
289}

291static inline Hit traceScene(float3 ro, float3 rd, device const Triangle *tris,
292 uint triCount) {
293 Hit best;
294 best.t = INFINITY;
295 best.hit = 0u;
296 best.materialID = -1;
297 best.n = float3(0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f);
298 best.uv = float2(0.0f);
299 best.tangent = float3(1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
300 best.bitangent = float3(0.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f);
301 best.triIndex = 0u;
302 best._pad0 = 0u;
303
304 for (uint i = 0; i < triCount; i++) {
305 float t, u, v;
306 if (rayTriangleMT(ro, rd, tris[i].v0.xyz, tris[i].v1.xyz,
307 tris[i].v2.xyz, t, u, v)) {
308 if (t < best.t) {
309 best.t = t;
310 float w = 1.0f - u - v;
311 float3 n = normalize(tris[i].n0.xyz * w + tris[i].n1.xyz * u +
312 tris[i].n2.xyz * v);
313 best.n = n;
314 best.uv =
315 tris[i].uv0.xy * w + tris[i].uv1.xy * u + tris[i].uv2.xy * v;
316 float3 tRaw = tris[i].t0.xyz * w + tris[i].t1.xyz * u +
317 tris[i].t2.xyz * v;
318 float tLen2 = dot(tRaw, tRaw);
319 best.tangent = (tLen2 > 1e-10f)
320 ? tRaw * rsqrt(tLen2)
321 : float3(1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
322 float3 bRaw = tris[i].b0.xyz * w + tris[i].b1.xyz * u +
323 tris[i].b2.xyz * v;
324 float bLen2 = dot(bRaw, bRaw);
325 best.bitangent = (bLen2 > 1e-10f)
326 ? bRaw * rsqrt(bLen2)
327 : float3(0.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f);
328 best.materialID = tris[i].materialID;
329 best.triIndex = i;
330 best.hit = 1u;
331 }
332 }
333 }
334
335 return best;
336}

703 float3 center = areaLights[i].position;
704 float3 right = safeNormalize(areaLights[i].right, float3(1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f));
705 float3 up = safeNormalize(areaLights[i].up, float3(0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f));

726 float nl = dot(lightNormal, -L);

4114static inline float2 octEncode(float3 n) {
4115 n /= (fabs(n.x) + fabs(n.y) + fabs(n.z) + 1e-6f);
4116 float2 e = n.xy;
4117
4118 if (n.z < 0.0f) {
4119 float2 signNotZero =
4120 float2(e.x >= 0.0f ? 1.0f : -1.0f, e.y >= 0.0f ? 1.0f : -1.0f);
4121 e = (1.0f - fabs(e.yx)) * signNotZero;
4122 }
4123 return e;
4124}

4138static inline float2 ddgiAtlasUV(uint probeIndex, float3 dirWS,
4139 constant ProbeSpace &ps, uint atlasW,
4140 uint atlasH) {
4141 if (atlasW == 0u || atlasH == 0u) {
4142 return float2(0.5f);
4143 }

4145 uint border = (uint)ps.atlasParams.x;
4146 uint innerRes = (uint)ps.atlasParams.y;
4147 uint probesPerRow = (uint)ps.atlasParams.z;
4148 if (innerRes == 0u || probesPerRow == 0u) {
4149 return float2(0.5f);
4150 }
4151
4152 uint tileRes = innerRes + 2u * border;
4153
4154 uint tileX = probeIndex % probesPerRow;
4155 uint tileY = probeIndex / probesPerRow;
4156
4157 float dirLen = length(dirWS);
4158 float3 safeDir =
4159 (dirLen > 1e-6f) ? (dirWS / float3(dirLen)) : float3(0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f);
4160 float2 e = octEncode(safeDir);
4161 float2 innerUV = e * 0.5f + 0.5f;
4162
4163 float2 innerPx = float2((float)(tileX * tileRes + border),
4164 (float)(tileY * tileRes + border)) +
4165 innerUV * float(innerRes - 1u);
4166
4167 return (innerPx + 0.5f) / float2((float)atlasW, (float)atlasH);

4170static inline float4 sampleDDGITextureBilinear(texture2d<float> tex,
4171 float2 uv) {
4172 uint w = tex.get_width();
4173 uint h = tex.get_height();
4174 if (w == 0u || h == 0u) {
4175 return float4(0.0f);
4176 }
4177
4178 float2 pixel = uv * float2((float)w, (float)h) - 0.5f;
4179 int2 p0 = int2(floor(pixel));
4180 int2 p1 = p0 + int2(1, 0);
4181 int2 p2 = p0 + int2(0, 1);
4182 int2 p3 = p0 + int2(1, 1);
4183
4184 int maxX = int(w) - 1;
4185 int maxY = int(h) - 1;
4186 p0 = int2(clamp(p0.x, 0, maxX), clamp(p0.y, 0, maxY));
4187 p1 = int2(clamp(p1.x, 0, maxX), clamp(p1.y, 0, maxY));
4188 p2 = int2(clamp(p2.x, 0, maxX), clamp(p2.y, 0, maxY));
4189 p3 = int2(clamp(p3.x, 0, maxX), clamp(p3.y, 0, maxY));
4190
4191 float2 f = fract(pixel);
4192 float4 c00 = tex.read(uint2((uint)p0.x, (uint)p0.y));
4193 float4 c10 = tex.read(uint2((uint)p1.x, (uint)p1.y));
4194 float4 c01 = tex.read(uint2((uint)p2.x, (uint)p2.y));
4195 float4 c11 = tex.read(uint2((uint)p3.x, (uint)p3.y));
4196 float4 cx0 = mix(c00, c10, f.x);
4197 float4 cx1 = mix(c01, c11, f.x);
4198 return mix(cx0, cx1, f.y);
4199}

6874bool isOccluded(intersector<triangle_data, instancing> isect,
6875 instance_acceleration_structure sceneAS, float3 P, float3 N,
6876 float3 L, float maxDistance) {

6886 return shadowHit.type != intersection_type::none;

6889bool isOccludedDirectionalLight(DirectionalLightData light, float3 P, float3 N,
6890 thread uint &rng,
6891 intersector<triangle_data, instancing> isect,
6892 instance_acceleration_structure sceneAS) {

6901 float3 L = normalize(jittered);

6945bool isOccludedAreaLight(AreaLight light, float3 P, float3 N,
6946 thread uint &rng,
6947 intersector<triangle_data, instancing> isect,
6948 instance_acceleration_structure sceneAS) {
6949 float2 u = float2(rand(rng), rand(rng));
6950 float2 rect = (u * 2.0 - 1.0) * 0.25;
6951 float3 sampledLightPos = light.position + light.right * rect.x +
6952 light.up * rect.y;
6953
6954 float3 toLight = sampledLightPos - P;
6955 float dist2 = max(dot(toLight, toLight), 1e-4);
6956 float dist = sqrt(dist2);
6957 float3 L = toLight / dist;
6958 return i)", R"(sOccluded(isect, sceneAS, P, N, L, dist - 0.001);
6959}
6960
6961// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
6962// PBR helpers: GGX / Cook-Torrance
6963// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
6964
6965float D_GGX(float NdotH, float roughness) {
6966 float a = max(roughness * roughness, 1e-4);
6967 float a2 = a * a;
6968 float d = (NdotH * NdotH) * (a2 - 1.0) + 1.0;
6969 return a2 / max(M_PI_F * d * d, 1e-6);
6970}
6971
6972float3 F_Schlick(float cosTheta, float3 F0) {
6973 float c = clamp(1.0 - cosTheta, 0.0, 1.0);
6974 return F0 + (1.0 - F0) * pow5(c);
6975}
6976
6977float G_Smith(float NdotV, float NdotL, float roughness) {
6978 float r = roughness + 1.0;
6979 float k = (r * r) / 8.0;
6980 float gV = NdotV / (NdotV * (1.0 - k) + k);
6981 float gL = NdotL / (NdotL * (1.0 - k) + k);
6982 return gV * gL;
6983}
6984
6985float disneyDiffuseFactor(float NdotV, float NdotL, float LdotH,
6986 float roughness) {
6987 float fd90 = 0.5 + 2.0 * LdotH * LdotH * roughness;
6988 float lightScatter = 1.0 + (fd90 - 1.0) * pow5(1.0 - NdotL);
6989 float viewScatter = 1.0 + (fd90 - 1.0) * pow5(1.0 - NdotV);
6990 return lightScatter * viewScatter;
6991}
6992
6993// GGX importance-sampled microfacet half-vector (in local TBN space, Z=up)
6994float3 sampleGGX(float2 u, float roughness) {
6995 float a = roughness * roughness;
6996 float phi = 2.0 * M_PI_F * u.x;
6997 float cosTheta = sqrt((1.0 - u.y) / max(1.0 + (a * a - 1.0) * u.y, 1e-7));
6998 float sinTheta = sqrt(max(0.0, 1.0 - cosTheta * cosTheta));
6999 return float3(sinTheta * cos(phi), sinTheta * sin(phi), cosTheta);
7000}
7001
7002// Full Cook-Torrance PBR for a single analytic light
7003float3 evalPBR(float3 albedo, float metallic, float roughness, float3 N,
7004 float3 V, float3 L, float3 lightColor, float intensity) {
7005 float3 H = normalize(V + L);
7006 float NdotL = max(dot(N, L), 0.0);
7007 float NdotV = max(dot(N, V), 1e-4);
7008 float NdotH = max(dot(N, H), 0.0);
7009 float VdotH = max(dot(V, H), 0.0);
7010
7011 float clampedRoughness = clamp(roughness, 0.045, 1.0);
7012 float3 F0 = mix(float3(0.04), albedo, clamp(metallic, 0.0, 1.0));
7013 float3 F = F_Schlick(VdotH, F0);
7014 float D = D_GGX(NdotH, clampedRoughness);
7015 float G = G_Smith(NdotV, NdotL, clampedRoughness);
7016
7017 float3 specular = (D * G * F) / max(4.0 * NdotV * NdotL, 1e-4);
7018 float3 kD = (1.0 - F) * (1.0 - clamp(metallic, 0.0, 1.0));
7019 float diffuseFactor = disneyDiffuseFactor(NdotV, NdotL, max(dot(L, H), 0.0),
7020 clampedRoughness);
7021 float3 diffuse = (kD * albedo * diffuseFactor) / M_PI_F;
7022
7023 return (diffuse + specular) * lightColor * intensity * NdotL;
7024}
7025
7026float3 evalSubsurface(float3 albedo, float3 N, float3 V, float3 L,
7027 float3 lightColor, float intensity, float roughness,
7028 float sssStrength, float sssThickness) {
7029 float NdotL = dot(N, L);
7030 float NdotV = max(dot(N, V), 0.0);
7031 float backLit = clamp(-NdotL, 0.0, 1.0);
7032 float wrapAmount = mix(0.2, 0.7, clamp(roughness, 0.0, 1.0));
7033 float wrapped = clamp((NdotL + wrapAmount) / (1.0 + wrapAmount), 0.0, 1.0);
7034 float viewScatter = pow(clamp(1.0 - max(dot(V, L), 0.0), 0.0, 1.0), 2.0);
7035 float transmission = backLit * (0.35 + 0.65 * viewScatter);
7036 float diffuseBleed = wrapped * (0.5 + 0.5 * (1.0 - NdotV));
7037 float profile = mix(diffuseBleed, transmission, 0.65);
7038 float thicknessFalloff = exp(-max(sssThickness, 0.01) * (1.0 - backLit));
7039 return (albedo * lightColor * intensity * sssStrength * profile *
7040 thicknessFalloff) /
7041 M_PI_F;
7042}
7043
7044float3 evalTransmission(float3 albedo, float3 N, float3 V, float3 L,
7045 float3 lightColor, float intensity, float roughness,
7046 float ior) {
7047 float3 H = normalize(V + L);
7048 float NdotL = max(dot(N, -L), 0.0);
7049 float VdotH = max(dot(V, H), 0.0);
7050 float3 F0 = float3(pow((ior - 1.0) / (ior + 1.0), 2.0));
7051 float3 F = F_Schlick(VdotH, F0);
7052 float3 transmitTint = mix(float3(1.0), albedo, 0.1);
7053 float3 transmitFactor = (1.0 - F) * transmitTint;
7054 float D = D_GGX(max(dot(N, H), 0.0), roughness);
7055 return transmitFactor * lightColor * intensity * D * NdotL * 2.2 / M_PI_F;
7056}
7057
7058// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
7059// Direct lighting with full PBR (replaces old evalDirectLighting)
7060// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
7061
7062float3 evalDirectLightingPBR(intersector<triangle_data, instancing> isect,
7063 instance_acceleration_structure sceneAS, float3 P,
7064 float3 N, float3 V, float3 albedo, float metallic,
7065 float roughness, float ior, float transmittance,
7066 float sssStrength, float sssThickness,
7067 thread uint &rng,
7068 constant DirectionalLightData &dirLight,
7069 constant SceneData &sceneData,
7070 constant PointLight *pointLights,
7071 constant SpotLight *spotLights,
7072 constant AreaLight *areaLights) {
7073 float3 lighting = float3(0.0);
7074 float surfaceOpacity =
7075 clamp(1.0 - transmittance * (1.0 - metallic), 0.0, 1.0);
7076
7077 // Directional
7078 if (sceneData.numDirectionalLights > 0) {
7079 float3 L = normalize(-dirLight.direction);
7080 float3 c = evalPBR(albedo, metallic, roughness, N, V, L, dirLight.color,
7081 max(dirLight.intensity, 0.0));
7082 float3 s = evalSubsurface(albedo, N, V, L, dirLight.color,
7083 max(dirLight.intensity, 0.0), roughness,
7084 sssStrength, sssThickness);
7085 float3 t =
7086 evalTransmission(albedo, N, V, L, dirLight.color,
7087 max(dirLight.intensity, 0.0), roughness, ior) *
7088 transmittance;
7089 if (!isOccludedDirectionalLight(dirLight, P, N, rng, isect, sceneAS)) {
7090 float3 lightContribution = clampLuminance((c + s) * surfaceOpacity, 8.0);
7091 lighting += lightContribution;
7092 lighting += clampLuminance(t, 12.0);
7093 }
7094 }
7095
7096 // Point lights
7097 for (uint i = 0; i < sceneData.numPointLights; ++i) {
7098 float3 toLight = pointLights[i].position - P;
7099 float dist = max(length(toLight), 1e-4);
7100 float3 L = toLight / dist;
7101 float lightRange = max(pointLights[i].range, 1e-4);
7102 float minDist = max(lightRange * 0.08, 0.15);
7103 float distSq = dist * dist + minDist * minDist;
7104 float rangeFade = 1.0 - smoothstep(lightRange * 0.75, lightRange, dist);
7105 float atten = rangeFade / max(distSq, 1e-4);
7106 float intensity = max(pointLights[i].intensity, 0.0) * atten;
7107 float3 c = evalPBR(albedo, metallic, roughness, N, V, L,
7108 pointLights[i].color, intensity);
7109 float3 s =
7110 evalSubsurface(albedo, N, V, L, pointLights[i].color, intensity,
7111 roughness, sssStrength, sssThickness);
7112 float3 t = evalTransmission(albedo, N, V, L, pointLights[i].color,
7113 intensity, roughness, ior) *
7114 transmittance;
7115 if (!isOccludedPointLight(pointLights[i], P, N, rng, isect, sceneAS)) {
7116 float3 lightContribution = clampLuminance((c + s) * surfaceOpacity, 8.0);
7117 lighting += lightContribution;
7118 lighting += clampLuminance(t, 12.0);
7119 }
7120 }
7121
7122 // Spot lights
7123 for (uint i = 0; i < sceneData.numSpotLights; ++i) {
7124 float3 toLight = spotLights[i].position - P;
7125 float dist = max(length(toLight), 1e-4);
7126 float3 L = toLight / dist;
7127 float3 fwd = normalize(spotLights[i].direction);
7128 float spotCos = dot(-L, fwd);
7129 float spot =
7130 smoothstep(spotLights[i].outerCos, spotLights[i].innerCos, spotCos);
7131 float lightRange = max(spotLights[i].range, 1e-4);
7132 float minDist = max(lightRange * 0.08, 0.15);
7133 float distSq = dist * dist + minDist * minDist;
7134 float rangeFade = 1.0 - smoothstep(lightRang)", R"(e * 0.75, lightRange, dist);
7135 float atten = rangeFade / max(distSq, 1e-4);
7136 float intensity = max(spotLights[i].intensity, 0.0) * atten * spot;
7137 float3 c = evalPBR(albedo, metallic, roughness, N, V, L,
7138 spotLights[i].color, intensity);
7139 float3 s =
7140 evalSubsurface(albedo, N, V, L, spotLights[i].color, intensity,
7141 roughness, sssStrength, sssThickness);
7142 float3 t = evalTransmission(albedo, N, V, L, spotLights[i].color,
7143 intensity, roughness, ior) *
7144 transmittance;
7145 if (!isOccludedSpotLight(spotLights[i], P, N, rng, isect, sceneAS)) {
7146 float3 lightContribution = clampLuminance((c + s) * surfaceOpacity, 8.0);
7147 lighting += lightContribution;
7148 lighting += clampLuminance(t, 12.0);
7149 }
7150 }
7151
7152 // Area lights
7153 for (uint i = 0; i < sceneData.numAreaLights; ++i) {
7154 float3 toLight = areaLights[i].position - P;
7155 float dist = max(length(toLight), 1e-4);
7156 float3 L = toLight / dist;
7157 float3 lightNorm =
7158 normalize(cross(areaLights[i].right, areaLights[i].up));
7159 float cosLight = areaLights[i].twoSided > 0.5
7160 ? abs(dot(lightNorm, -L))
7161 : max(dot(lightNorm, -L), 0.0);
7162 float area = 4.0 * areaLights[i].halfWidth * areaLights[i].halfHeight;
7163 float minDist = max(
7164 max(areaLights[i].halfWidth, areaLights[i].halfHeight) * 0.5, 0.15);
7165 float distSq = dist * dist + minDist * minDist;
7166 float atten = (cosLight * area) / max(distSq, 1e-4);
7167 float intensity = max(areaLights[i].intensity, 0.0) * atten;
7168 float3 c = evalPBR(albedo, metallic, roughness, N, V, L,
7169 areaLights[i].color, intensity);
7170 float3 s =
7171 evalSubsurface(albedo, N, V, L, areaLights[i].color, intensity,
7172 roughness, sssStrength, sssThickness);
7173 float3 t = evalTransmission(albedo, N, V, L, areaLights[i].color,
7174 intensity, roughness, ior) *
7175 transmittance;
7176 if (!isOccludedAreaLight(areaLights[i], P, N, rng, isect, sceneAS)) {
7177 float3 lightContribution = clampLuminance((c + s) * surfaceOpacity, 8.0);
7178 lighting += lightContribution;
7179 lighting += clampLuminance(t, 12.0);
7180 }
7181 }
7182
7183 return lighting;
7184}
7185
7186// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
7187// sampleRadiance — primary path with GGX importance-sampled indirect bounce
7188// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
7189
7190float3 sampleRadiance(uint2 gid, uint sampleIndex, uint w,
7191 intersector<triangle_data, instancing> isect,
7192 instance_acceleration_structure sceneAS, ray primaryRay,
7193 constant Material *materials, constant MeshData *meshData,
7194 constant VertexData *vertices, constant uint *indices,
7195 constant InstanceData *instanceData,
7196 constant DirectionalLightData &dirLight,
7197 constant SceneData &sceneData,
7198 constant PointLight *pointLights,
7199 constant SpotLight *spotLights,
7200 constant AreaLight *areaLights,
7201 PT_MATERIAL_TEXTURE_PARAMS, texturecube<float> skybox) {
7202 uint rng = seedBase(gid, w, sceneData.frameIndex, sampleIndex);
7203
7204 ray surfaceRay = primaryRay;
7205 auto hit = isect.intersect(surfaceRay, sceneAS, 0xFF);
7206 Material mat{};
7207 MeshData mesh{};
7208 InstanceData inst{};
7209 float2 texUV = float2(0.0);
7210 float3 localN = float3(0.0, 1.0, 0.0);
7211 float3 localT = float3(1.0, 0.0, 0.0);
7212 float3 localB = float3(0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
7213 bool foundOpaqueSurface = false;
7214
7215 for (uint step = 0; step < 8; ++step) {
7216 if (hit.type == intersection_type::none) {
7217 return skyColor(surfaceRay.direction, 0.0, skybox);
7218 }
7219
7220 uint instanceIndex = hit.instance_id;
7221 uint primitiveIndex = hit.primitive_id;
7222
7223 mat = materials[instanceIndex];
7224 mesh = meshData[instanceIndex];
7225 inst = instanceData[instanceIndex];
7226
7227 uint i0 = indices[mesh.indexOffset + primitiveIndex * 3 + 0];
7228 uint i1 = indices[mesh.indexOffset + primitiveIndex * 3 + 1];
7229 uint i2 = indices[mesh.indexOffset + primitiveIndex * 3 + 2];
7230
7231 float2 bary = hit.triangle_barycentric_coord;
7232 float b0 = 1.0 - bary.x - bary.y;
7233 float b1 = bary.x;
7234 float b2 = bary.y;
7235
7236 texUV = float2(vertices[i0].uv) * b0 + float2(vertices[i1].uv) * b1 +
7237 float2(vertices[i2].uv) * b2;
7238 localN = normalizeOr(float3(vertices[i0].normal) * b0 +
7239 float3(vertices[i1].normal) * b1 +
7240 float3(vertices[i2].normal) * b2,
7241 float3(0.0, 1.0, 0.0));
7242 localT = normalizeOr(float3(vertices[i0].tangent) * b0 +
7243 float3(vertices[i1].tangent) * b1 +
7244 float3(vertices[i2].tangent) * b2,
7245 float3(1.0, 0.0, 0.0));
7246 localB = normalizeOr(float3(vertices[i0].bitangent) * b0 +
7247 float3(vertices[i1].bitangent) * b1 +
7248 float3(vertices[i2].bitangent) * b2,
7249 float3(0.0, 0.0, 1.0));
7250
7251 float alpha = 1.0;
7252 if (mat.opacityTextureIndex >= 0 &&
7253 uint(mat.opacityTextureIndex) < sceneData.materialTextureCount) {
7254 alpha = clamp(sampleMaterialTexture(mat.opacityTextureIndex, texUV,
7255 PT_MATERIAL_TEXTURE_ARGS)
7256 .x,
7257 0.0, 1.0);
7258 }
7259
7260 if (alpha >= 0.1) {
7261 foundOpaqueSurface = true;
7262 break;
7263 }
7264
7265 surfaceRay.origin =
7266 surfaceRay.origin + surfaceRay.direction * (hit.distance + 0.001);
7267 surfaceRay.min_distance = 0.0;
7268 surfaceRay.max_distance = primaryRay.max_distance;
7269 hit = isect.intersect(surfaceRay, sceneAS, 0xFF);
7270 }
7271
7272 if (!foundOpaqueSurface) {
7273 return skyColor(surfaceRay.direction, 0.0, skybox);
7274 }
7275
7276 float3 N = resolveShadingNormal(mat, texUV, localN, localT, localB, inst,
7277 sceneData.materialTextureCount,
7278 PT_MATERIAL_TEXTURE_ARGS);
7279 float3 P = surfaceRay.origin + surfaceRay.direction * hit.distance;
7280 float3 V = normalize(-surfaceRay.direction);
7281 if (dot(N, V) < 0.0) {
7282 N = -N;
7283 }
7284
7285 float3 albedo;
7286 float metallic;
7287 float roughness;
7288 float ao;
7289 float3 emissive;
7290 float ior;
7291 float transmittance;
7292 resolveMaterialParameters(mat, texUV, sceneData.materialTextureCount,
7293 PT_MATERIAL_TEXTURE_ARGS, albedo, metallic,
7294 roughness, ao, emissive, ior, transmittance);
7295 float sssStrength = clamp(1.0 - mat.albedo.w, 0.0, 1.0) * (1.0 - metallic);
7296 float sssThickness = mix(0.25, 1.75, ao);
7297
7298 float3 direct = evalDirectLightingPBR(
7299 isect, sceneAS, P, N, V, albedo, metallic, roughness, ior,
7300 transmittance, sssStrength, sssThickness, rng, dirLight, sceneData,
7301 pointLights, spotLights, areaLights);
7302
7303 float3 indirect = float3(0.0);
7304
7305 if (sceneData.maxBounces > 0) {
7306 float3 F0 = mix(float3(0.04), albedo, metallic);
7307 float3 F_approx = F_Schlick(max(dot(N, V), 0.0), F0);
7308
7309 float dielectricF0 = pow((ior - 1.0) / (ior + 1.0), 2.0);
7310 float dielectricSpec =
7311 F_Schlick(max(dot(N, V), 0.0), float3(dielectricF0)).x;
7312 float specProb = metallic * mix(0.35, 0.9, 1.0 - roughness) +
7313 (1.0 - metallic) * dielectricSpec;
7314 float transmitProb =
7315 transmittance * (1.0 - metallic) * (1.0 - dielectricSpec);
7316 float diffuseProb = (1.0 - metallic) * (1.0 - transmittance)", R"();
7317 float probSum = max(specProb + transmitProb + diffuseProb, 1e-4);
7318 specProb /= probSum;
7319 transmitProb /= probSum;
7320 diffuseProb /= probSum;
7321
7322 float3x3 basis = buildOrthonormalBasis(N);
7323 ray bounceRay;
7324 bounceRay.origin = P + N * 0.001;
7325 bounceRay.min_distance = 0.0;
7326 bounceRay.max_distance = 1.0e30;
7327
7328 float3 brdfWeight;
7329 float chooseSplit = rand(rng);
7330 bool choseTransmission = false;
7331
7332 if (specProb > 1e-4 && chooseSplit < specProb) {
7333 float2 u = float2(rand(rng), rand(rng));
7334 float3 localH = sampleGGX(u, max(roughness, 0.001));
7335 float3 H_world = normalize(basis * localH);
7336 float3 bounceDir = reflect(-V, H_world);
7337
7338 if (dot(bounceDir, N) <= 0.0)
7339 bounceDir = reflect(-V, N);
7340
7341 bounceRay.direction = bounceDir;
7342
7343 float NdotL2 = max(dot(N, bounceDir), 1e-4);
7344 float NdotV2 = max(dot(N, V), 1e-4);
7345 float3 Fs = F_Schlick(max(dot(V, H_world), 0.0), F0);
7346 float Gs = G_Smith(NdotV2, NdotL2, roughness);
7347
7348 brdfWeight =
7349 (Fs * Gs / max(4.0 * NdotV2, 1e-4)) / max(specProb, 1e-4);
7350
7351 } else if (transmitProb > 1e-4 && chooseSplit < specProb + transmitProb) {
7352 choseTransmission = true;
7353 bool entering = dot(N, V) > 0.0;
7354 float eta = entering ? (1.0 / ior) : ior;
7355 float3 faceN = entering ? N : -N;
7356
7357 float3 refractDir = refract(-V, faceN, eta);
7358
7359 if (length(refractDir) < 1e-5) {
7360 refractDir = reflect(-V, faceN);
7361 }
7362
7363 bounceRay.origin = P - faceN * 0.002;
7364 bounceRay.direction = normalize(refractDir);
7365
7366 float3 F0t = float3(pow((ior - 1.0) / (ior + 1.0), 2.0));
7367 float3 Ft = F_Schlick(max(dot(V, faceN), 0.0), F0t);
7368 float3 kT = (1.0 - Ft) * mix(float3(1.0), albedo, 0.15);
7369
7370 float3 absorption = exp(-(1.0 - albedo) * 0.12);
7371
7372 brdfWeight = (kT * absorption) / max(transmitProb, 1e-4);
7373
7374 } else {
7375 float2 u = float2(rand(rng), rand(rng));
7376 float3 localBounce = cosineSampleHemisphere(u);
7377 bounceRay.direction = normalize(basis * localBounce);
7378
7379 float3 kD = (1.0 - F_approx) * (1.0 - metallic);
7380 brdfWeight = (kD * albedo) / max(diffuseProb, 1e-4);
7381 }
7382
7383 brdfWeight = clamp(brdfWeight, float3(0.0), float3(8.0));
7384
7385 auto bounceHit = isect.intersect(bounceRay, sceneAS, 0xFF);
7386 auto resolvedBounceHit = bounceHit;
7387 ray resolvedBounceRay = bounceRay;
7388
7389 if (choseTransmission) {
7390 for (uint shellStep = 0; shellStep < 8; ++shellStep) {
7391 if (resolvedBounceHit.type == intersection_type::none) {
7392 break;
7393 }
7394
7395 uint ti = resolvedBounceHit.instance_id;
7396 uint tp = resolvedBounceHit.primitive_id;
7397
7398 Material tmat = materials[ti];
7399 MeshData tmesh = meshData[ti];
7400 InstanceData tinst = instanceData[ti];
7401
7402 uint tj0 = indices[tmesh.indexOffset + tp * 3 + 0];
7403 uint tj1 = indices[tmesh.indexOffset + tp * 3 + 1];
7404 uint tj2 = indices[tmesh.indexOffset + tp * 3 + 2];
7405
7406 float2 tbary = resolvedBounceHit.triangle_barycentric_coord;
7407 float tb0 = 1.0 - tbary.x - tbary.y;
7408 float tb1 = tbary.x;
7409 float tb2 = tbary.y;
7410
7411 float2 tUV = float2(vertices[tj0].uv) * tb0 +
7412 float2(vertices[tj1].uv) * tb1 +
7413 float2(vertices[tj2].uv) * tb2;
7414 float3 tLocalN = normalizeOr(float3(vertices[tj0].normal) * tb0 +
7415 float3(vertices[tj1].normal) * tb1 +
7416 float3(vertices[tj2].normal) * tb2,
7417 float3(0.0, 1.0, 0.0));
7418 float3 tLocalT = normalizeOr(float3(vertices[tj0].tangent) * tb0 +
7419 float3(vertices[tj1].tangent) * tb1 +
7420 float3(vertices[tj2].tangent) * tb2,
7421 float3(1.0, 0.0, 0.0));
7422 float3 tLocalB = normalizeOr(float3(vertices[tj0].bitangent) * tb0 +
7423 float3(vertices[tj1].bitangent) * tb1 +
7424 float3(vertices[tj2].bitangent) * tb2,
7425 float3(0.0, 0.0, 1.0));
7426
7427 float3 tN = resolveShadingNormal(tmat, tUV, tLocalN, tLocalT,
7428 tLocalB, tinst,
7429 sceneData.materialTextureCount,
7430 PT_MATERIAL_TEXTURE_ARGS);
7431 float3 tP = resolvedBounceRay.origin +
7432 resolvedBounceRay.direction * resolvedBounceHit.distance;
7433 float3 tV = normalize(-resolvedBounceRay.direction);
7434 if (dot(tN, tV) < 0.0) {
7435 tN = -tN;
7436 }
7437
7438 float3 tAlbedo;
7439 float tMetallic;
7440 float tRoughness;
7441 float tAo;
7442 float3 tEmissive;
7443 float tIor;
7444 float tTransmittance;
7445 resolveMaterialParameters(
7446 tmat, tUV, sceneData.materialTextureCount,
7447 PT_MATERIAL_TEXTURE_ARGS, tAlbedo, tMetallic, tRoughness, tAo,
7448 tEmissive, tIor, tTransmittance);
